cover.desc: Full color, Layer 3 palette — cel shading, hard shadows, warm cheap-neon palette against pale negative space. A fried chicken shop by a level crossing at night: orange moulded plastic booth seats, a laminated menu board, a paper tray of nine pieces steaming in the middle of a formica table, two paper cups. Kanade sits on one side in her academy uniform with her coat still on and her gloves still on, hair up in the precise twist, sitting bolt upright with her hands flat on the table and a public smile that is doing far too much work. Kou sits opposite in his uniform, coat off, absolutely upright, hands in his lap, expression completely flat — solid black hair as the darkest mass in the frame. Between them, the tray. Above them, a strip light. Neither of them has touched anything. The gap between the two figures is the widest in any panel of the series so far and the composition should make that gap the actual subject. Through the window behind them, a barrier arm coming down and a train going past in a smear of light.

panels.action: He could still get out of this. He has a version ready. He has had one ready for two years.

dialogue.text: Everybody on the front line's spent a few.

Four doesn't eat number six and say it's fine.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, seated, upright

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, seated, head slightly down

panels.action: The train goes past outside and neither of them says anything for the whole of it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: quiet, careful, deliberately not making it big

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: seated

panels.bg: the booth, the train gone, strip light, quiet shop
panels.action: She has learned something in four days: how to not escalate.

dialogue.text: I'm not going to shout about this.
You shout about everything.
I know. I'm not going to.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, and something in it that is almost relief
chars.pose: turning the cup on the table

panels.bg: the cup, the formica, strip light, flat tone
panels.action: Nobody has ever gone quiet at him. They usually go loud, and loud is easy.

dialogue.text: It's not interesting. It's just arithmetic.
Then it'll be a very short answer.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not answering, looking out at the crossing

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: watching him not answer

panels.bg: the window, the barrier arm coming up, the wet road, strip light
panels.action: Nine seconds. She counts them and does not fill a single one.

dialogue.text: Nine seconds. He's never taken nine seconds on anything.
On thirty-one he called three targets in under two.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: flat, deflecting with the only thing he has

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: looking up at him

panels.bg: the booth, the shop, strip light, the counter behind
panels.action: He stands up. It is the least subtle thing he has ever done.

dialogue.text: They're closing at ten.
They close at eleven.
...They're closing at eleven.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing too, pulling her coat on, not chasing it

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: at the end of the table, waiting

panels.bg: the shop, the door, the crossing beyond, strip light
panels.action: She lets him have it. She physically has to make herself do that, and she does it.

dialogue.text: Fine. Walk me to the crossing.
It's four metres away.
Then it'll be a very short walk.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: walking, hands in coat pockets, hair still up

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: walking, hands in pockets

panels.action: Four metres takes them about eleven minutes because neither of them walks toward it.

dialogue.text: You know Ōkubo's going to ask you about tonight.
He is.
What are you going to tell him?
Haven't decided. Probably something true-adjacent.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sideways glance, testing something

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: walking

panels.bg: the wet road, neon, shutters, night
panels.action: She has been building up to this since the table and she does it badly on purpose.

dialogue.text: Riko knows. About you. She worked it out on Wednesday.
I assumed.
You're not going to ask what she's going to do about it?
She forges your gate logs. She's not going to do anything.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: laughing, one hand over her mouth

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, stopping with her

panels.bg: the road, neon, night, soft bokeh overlay
panels.action: Four people now hold the whole thing between them and none of them will ever say so.

dialogue.text: That is a horrifying amount of leverage in one road.
Mm.
Doesn't it worry you at all?
No.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopped by how flatly he said that

panels.bg: night, neon, flat tone, close
panels.action: It is the least defended thing he has said all evening and he does not appear to notice.

dialogue.text: Why not?
Because it's you.
That's the whole reason. There isn't a second one.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, scarlet, spinning away, steam venting
chars.pose: chibi, marching off toward the crossing

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, entirely unaware of what he did

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. He has no idea. He genuinely has no idea.

dialogue.text: You can't just SAY things like that on a road!
You said worse on layer thirty-two.
THAT WAS A DUNGEON. DUNGEON RULES.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, at the crossing, calming down, breath visible

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: beside her

panels.action: Her train is nine minutes away. Neither of them mentions that.

dialogue.text: That was a good evening.
It was ninety minutes of catastrophe and then it was fine.
That's what a good evening is, Hazama.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, and the monologue underneath it doing something enormous

panels.bg: the crossing, cold night, neon behind, flat tone
panels.action: Four hours. It is the longest he has spoken to anyone on the ground floor in four years.

dialogue.text: Four hours. On the ground. Without a handle.
I've said more tonight than I've said all year down here.
And she still knows more about me than she did at half seven.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not looking at him, saying it to the barrier arm

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: listening

panels.bg: the crossing, the barrier, cold night
panels.action: She has been holding it since the booth and she is not going to let it go.

dialogue.text: I'm going to ask you the thing.
I know.
I gave you ninety minutes.
You did.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: turning to face him properly, gloves off again

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not moving

panels.bg: the crossing, warning lights beginning to flash, cold night, hard alternating light
panels.action: Layer thirty-two, black water, six days ago. He said four words and she has kept them.

dialogue.text: On thirty-two I asked you what your count was.
You said: ask me on the ground.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: entirely level, no smile anywhere on her, bare hands at her sides

panels.bg: the crossing, the warning lights alternating hard across her face, cold night, everything else flat black tone
panels.action: Six days, four hours, and one piece of chicken.

dialogue.text: Hazama. We're on the ground.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the flat face, and behind it two years of never having been asked

panels.bg: the crossing, alternating warning light, flat tone
panels.action: Nobody has asked him that. Nabari has never asked. Gen does not know there is a number.

dialogue.text: Shizu reads it out every time and writes it down.
She's the only person who's ever said it in front of me.
And she can't mind. That's why it's safe.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: trying one last exit and knowing it won't work

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not moving an inch

panels.bg: the crossing, barrier coming down, flashing lights, night
panels.action: The barrier comes down between them and the other side of the road.

dialogue.text: Your train's in four minutes.
There's another one at eleven twenty.
You have a curfew.
I have forged gate logs. I'll cope.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: quiet, and doing the single hardest thing available to her, which is waiting

panels.bg: the crossing, alternating light, flat tone, close
panels.action: She does not fill it. Thirteen months of filling every silence he ever left, and she does not fill this one.

dialogue.text: Don't fill it. Don't fill it. Don't fill it.
He fills nothing and it's the only reason I ever say anything.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: giving up on the exits, and it looks like something being set down

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: waiting

panels.bg: the crossing, the train coming, hard light sweeping across them
panels.action: He puts it down. It takes him about four seconds.

dialogue.text: You're going to do a thing with your face.

You will. Everybody does.
Then I'll do it and we'll both live through it.

chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

dialogue.text: Ten.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hearing it, and doing absolutely nothing with her face, which costs her everything

panels.action: She said she wouldn't do a thing with her face. She does not do a thing with her face.

dialogue.text: Ten.

Ten is taste, smell, temperature, and most of pain.
Ten is Kirisu with one eye covered, two off.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: watching her not react, and finding that harder than being reacted to

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: level

panels.action: Nine seconds of her not saying anything at all.

dialogue.text: You're doing a thing with your face.

That's the thing.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: letting her, entirely still
